name: Orient International Enterprise, Ltd.
summary: Orient International Enterprise, Ltd. engages in logistics business in China and internationally. The company imports and exports commodities for textile raw materials and textile products and mechanical and electrical products; and medical devices, including MRI, linac, CT imaging system, digital angiograph, biochemical analyzer, surgical instruments, and other medical equipment and instruments. It also provides warehousing, air freight, shipping and transportation, and international logistics services; and domestic trade in e-commerce, food, and light textile clothing products. In addition, the company imports and exports textile and garments comprising fabric, various home textiles, knitted wears, shirt, T-shirts, and jackets or men and women under the Kool, Rose, Milky Way, Sparrow333 and LEETAI brands; international procurement, tender, and import for medical equipment, IT products, and telecommunications products and equipment sets, as well as steel and iron, coal, wood, chemical raw materials, wool and cotton. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Shanghai, China. Orient International Enterprise, Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Orient International (Holding) Co., Ltd.
